films.title: Black Friday
films.overview: Bombs tear through Bombay in 1993, wreaking havoc and polarising the citizens. With perpetrators at large, the state launches a massive man-hunt to unmask the perpetrators behind these events.

films.title: No Smoking
films.overview: A heavily addicted smoker is unprepared for the true price he must pay when he asks a guru's help to kick the habit.

films.title: Dev.D
films.overview: Dev, after spurning his childhood love Paro due to a misunderstanding, turns to drugs and alcohol for solace. Paro moves on but Dev remains in remorse. He then meets Chanda, an escort navigating her own past trauma, but Dev’s chauvinistic attitude and penchant for self-destruction stands in the way of their developing bond.

films.title: Gangs of Wasseypur - Part 2
films.overview: After the death of his father and brother Danish, Faizal Khan vows to take revenge by destroying Ramadhir Singh's gang.

films.title: Gangs of Wasseypur - Part 1
films.overview: In 1970s India, Sardar Khan vows to take revenge on the man who killed his father decades earlier.

films.title: Ugly
films.overview: When a 10-year old girl goes missing, her stepfather races against time to investigate the kidnapping.

films.title: Bombay Talkies
films.overview: One hundred years of Hindi cinema is celebrated in four short stories showcasing the power of film.

films.title: That Girl in Yellow Boots
films.overview: An Anglo-Indian woman works in a seedy Mumbai massage parlor while trying to find her long-lost father.

films.title: Raman Raghav 2.0
films.overview: A corrupt cop and a serial killer obsessed with a psychopath from the '60s get caught up in a ruthless cat-and-mouse game.

films.title: Gulaal
films.overview: A law student witnesses the struggles of the Rajputs, deception, homicide and crime after being elected as General Secretary of his college.

films.title: Mukkabaaz
films.overview: A low caste boxer, Shravan, trains at a gym controlled by a local Don, Mishra. Shravan falls for Mishra's niece, Sunaina. Mishra does not approve of this match. Shravan strives to win Sunaina's hand in marriage and become a successful boxer while trying to avoid retaliation from Mishra.

films.title: Manmarziyaan
films.overview: A spirited girl finds herself caught in a complicated love triangle while burdened with societal and familial pressures.

films.title: Lust Stories
films.overview: An anthology of four stories that sheds light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman.

films.title: Ghost Stories
films.overview: An anthology of four short horror tales.
